text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-The European Union's Middle East envoy Moratinos said his "full withdrawal for full security" formula to revive stalled peace talks in the region satisfies all concerned parties.
-Lebanon's weekly treasury bill issue of March 6 raised 272.9 billion Lebanese pounds. The issue posted a nominal surplus of subscription against maturity of 109.1 billion pounds.
-The highest court in Lebanon will on May 9 issue its sentence in the trial of former Christian warlord Geagea for the 1991 attempted assassination of the Defence Minister Murr.
-A car bomb wounded an Israeli soldier in Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
-Parliament speaker Berri will meet Syrian President Assad in Damascus today to discuss regional peace process.
-Lebanon signed a maritime cooperation agreement with Jordan.

-The U.S. veto of a U.N. resolution condemning Israel's decision to build houses in East Jerusalem encourages Israel to challenge the international community. Minister of Administrative Reform Merhej said.
